CanAccept:
(fn CanAccept (Instigator)
  (bind _carriedactor (Class|ACCarrying|GetCarried (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_CoopCharacter Instigator)))
  (bind _active (CallFunction|IsRoundActive))
  (if (and (Networking|HasAuthority) (and (not (Variables|Default|GetCompleted)) (and (not (Variables|Default|GetTransactionBusy)) _active)))
    (Utilities|IsValid Instigator
      (:"Is Valid"
        (bind _asbp_coop_character (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_CoopCharacter Instigator)
          (:then
            (if (and (not (Actor|ActorHasTag _asbp_coop_character "Downed")) (<= (Transformation|GetDistanceTo _asbp_coop_character) 400.0))
              (Utilities|IsValid _carriedactor
                (:"Is Valid"
                  (bind _asbp_key_relic (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_KeyRelic _carriedactor)
                    (:then
                      (bind (_state _who) (Class|BPCarryable|GetCarryState _asbp_key_relic))
                      (if (and (== _state 1) (Utilities|Equal(Object) _who _asbp_coop_character))
                        (Variables|Default|SetCandidateCharacter _asbp_coop_character)
                        (Variables|Default|SetCandidateKey _asbp_key_relic)
                        (return true)
                        (else
                          (return false))))
                    (:CastFailed
                      (return false))))
                (:"Is Not Valid"
                  (return false)))
              (else
                (return false))))
          (:CastFailed
            (return false))))
      (:"Is Not Valid"
        (return false)))
    (else
      (return false))))
AcceptKey:
(fn AcceptKey (Instigator)
  (bind _allowed (CallFunction|CanAccept Instigator))
  (if _allowed
    (bind _asbp_coop_game_mode (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_CoopGameMode (Game|GetGameMode)))
    (Variables|Default|SetTransactionBusy true)
    (bind _asbp_coop_character (Utilities|Casting|CastToBP_CoopCharacter (Variables|Default|GetCandidateCharacter))
      (:then
        (bind _carriedactor (Class|ACCarrying|ReleaseCarried _asbp_coop_character))
        (if (Utilities|Equal(Object) _carriedactor (Variables|Default|GetCandidateKey))
          (|SetwithNotifyPlacedKey _carriedactor)
          (bind _returnvalue (Transformation|AttachActorToComponent _carriedactor (Variables|Default|GetAltarSocket) (Variables|Default|GetSocketName) "SnapToTarget" "SnapToTarget" "KeepWorld" false))
          (if _returnvalue
            (|SetwithNotifyCompleted true)
            (Variables|Default|SetAcceptCount (+ (Variables|Default|GetAcceptCount) 1))
            (CallFunction|ApplyAltarState)
            (Networking|ForceNetUpdate)
            (Variables|Default|SetClearCallCount (+ (Variables|Default|GetClearCallCount) 1))
            (Class|BPCoopGameMode|ClearRound _asbp_coop_game_mode)
            (else
              (Class|BPGauntletGate|ResetforRound _carriedactor 2)
              (|SetwithNotifyPlacedKey 0))))
        (Variables|Default|SetTransactionBusy false))
      (:CastFailed
        (Variables|Default|SetTransactionBusy false)))))
EventGraph:
(event EventBeginPlay
  (CallFunction|BeginAltar))

(event EventInteract (Instigator)
  (CallFunction|AcceptKey Instigator))

(event EventResetForRound (Index Attempt)
  (CallFunction|ResetAltar Index Attempt))
CanInteract:
(fn CanInteract (Instigator)
  (Utilities|IsValid Instigator
    (:"Is Valid"
      (if (Networking|HasAuthority)
        (bind _allowed (CallFunction|CanAccept Instigator))
        (return _allowed)
        (else
          (bind _active (CallFunction|IsRoundActive))
          (return (and (not (Variables|Default|GetCompleted)) _active)))))
    (:"Is Not Valid"
      (return false))))
